subject.title: [codex] mirror proactive deliveries into session transcripts

question: Should proactive heartbeat context be durable replayable conversation state, or one-shot next-user-turn awareness consistent with the merged cron design?
rationale: The correct implementation boundary determines persistence, replay, deduplication, session locking, and whether proactive content should remain in future turns; automation should not choose that contract implicitly.

options.title: Use one-shot awareness
options.body: Route successful heartbeat delivery into a replay-safe next-turn context queue while retaining transcript mirrors only as non-replayed audit history.

options.title: Define durable replay semantics
options.body: Explicitly make selected proactive messages replayable, with filtering, deduplication, lock-safety, compaction, and provider-compatibility tests across all affected runtimes.

recommendation.title: Use one-shot awareness
recommendation.body: Route successful heartbeat delivery into a replay-safe next-turn context queue while retaining transcript mirrors only as non-replayed audit history.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans the documented agents and cron ownership area and must align heartbeat behavior with the merged cron contract.
